{{Quote|The Trade Federation Airbase is preparing to launch an attack against Naboo. You must stop it.|[[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] to Lieutenant Sykes|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The '''Trade Federation Airbase''' established by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] was [[Battle of the south ridge|destroyed]] by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Security Force]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] late in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==History==
{{Quote|For the Queen!|Sykes dedicates the base's destruction to Naboo's Queen.|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> and this base was established during that time period near the south ridge of Naboo's capital [[City/Legends|city]], [[Theed/Legends|Theed]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
During a [[Battle of the south ridge|skirmish]] with a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] convoy on its way through [[Widow's Valley]], [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] dropped a [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] from his [[NB-1S Royal Bomber|bomber]] on the base, hitting combustible materials and destroying the Airbase utterly.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}
Lieutenant Sykes dedicated the Airbase's destruction to the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] of Naboo. At the time of its destruction, the base was preparing for an attack.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
This base appears in a mission from the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. The player is asked to destroy the base, but it is not necessary and the game proceeds regardless.
